\textbf{Repository:} \texttt{scikit-hep/awkward}

\subsubsection*{Issue}
\begin{quote}
Regular indexing behaves like jagged index for RegularArray (v2)

\#\#\# Version of Awkward Array

c2ddda2f67abf2d7b3112e5752c7c34c3467052d

\#\#\# Description and code to reproduce

```pycon
>>> array = ak.from\_numpy(np.arange(4 * 4).reshape(4, 4))
>>> array[array > 4].ndim
2
>>> (array > 4).layout.purelist\_isregular
True
>>> array[ak.to\_numpy(array > 4)].ndim
1
```

\#\#\# Cause

The NumPy-like indexing checks for `NumpyArray`, not `RegularArray`.
\end{quote}

\subsubsection*{Gold Patch}
7 file(s) changed: \texttt{src/awkward/\_slicing.py}, \texttt{src/awkward/contents/content.py}, \texttt{src/awkward/contents/indexedoptionarray.py}, \texttt{src/awkward/contents/listarray.py}, \texttt{src/awkward/contents/listoffsetarray.py} (+2 more). +31/$-$16 lines.

\subsubsection*{Oracle Tests}
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Python, basicstyle=\tiny\ttfamily]
import numpy
# Compatibility shim for NumPy 2.x where AxisError moved to numpy.exceptions
if not hasattr(numpy, 'AxisError'):
    numpy.AxisError = numpy.exceptions.AxisError

import awkward as ak


def test_oracle_001():
    # RegularArray boolean index should behave like NumPy (1D result), not jagged (2D)
    array = ak.from_numpy(numpy.arange(4 * 4).reshape(4, 4))
    mask = array > 4
    result = array[mask]
    # NumPy behaviour: boolean indexing on a 2D array with a 2D boolean mask
    # of same shape returns a 1D result
    assert result.ndim == 1


def test_oracle_002():
    # Confirm the mask is purelist_regular (RegularArray), not jagged
    array = ak.from_numpy(numpy.arange(4 * 4).reshape(4, 4))
    mask = array > 4
    assert mask.layout.purelist_isregular is True
    # With the fix, indexing by this regular boolean mask gives ndim==1
    result = array[mask]
    assert result.ndim == 1


def test_oracle_003():
    # Indexing with ak boolean array vs numpy boolean array should give same ndim
    array = ak.from_numpy(numpy.arange(4 * 4).reshape(4, 4))
    ak_mask = array > 4
    np_mask = ak.to_numpy(ak_mask)
    result_ak = array[ak_mask]
    result_np = array[np_mask]
    assert result_ak.ndim == result_np.ndim
\end{lstlisting}
